name: the way out
did: Coastline has a street now, with two more houses on it, seven abandoned cars and insides for all four -- partitions, doorways and furniture, so a house is rooms and not a cave. Four doors to buy, and each one opens a barricade inside that house. And there is a way off the map: a jerry can in the last house on the street, a boat moored past the hole in the pier, and a lake with nothing on the other side of it.
onAccept: Your round is saved and the map is rebuilt. You keep your points, your guns and your perks, and the dead hold off for three minutes while you get set.
